text: hm. no not really. well so the paint is hitting the brush outline, but the brush is not hitting the grid correctly.
resolution: The brush cell snapped to integer texel boundaries while the grid LINES were drawn as round(slotWidth) equal divisions of the face's UV slot. After fit-scaling, the slot width isn't a whole number of texels, so the equal divisions drifted off the real cell boundaries — the brush 'didn't hit the grid.' Fixed the overlay to draw grid lines at the actual integer-texel positions (a = (k − rect.x0)/rw), which are exactly the cell edges — so the grid lines, the brush cursor cell, and the painted result all coincide. meshPaint 6/6, Studio bundles clean, hot-reload.
